"I want to start by thanking Council for initiating this important conversation on artificial intelligence policy back in January. I want to thank you for your leadership — it set the foundation for everything that has followed since."

"Over the past year our team has been learning, experimenting, and engaging with experts including workshops and hearing... at Harvard to ensure our approach reflects best practices and carries value. The feedback you shared during the September work session helped shape the data governance strategy and AI policies before you today."
"This has truly been a one-community effort built through cross-department collaboration and shared learning to ensure we move forward together with both curiosity and care."

"People first — data and AI is not about technology. It's about people. We are listening, building trust through transparency, and ensuring staff and residents feel informed, supported, and included in this transition."

"Evolution — we're taking an iterative approach: starting small, learning fast, testing and refining as we go through small pilots and real-world use cases. We continually adapt to community needs and emerging technology."

"Working smart — by integrating strong data governance with AI, we create the potential to reduce routine work, improve access to information, and give staff more time to focus on higher-value priorities. This approach can strengthen data-driven decisions and help us work more efficiently and responsibly for our community."
"Anyone can lead — data and AI belongs to everyone, not just IT. We're creating space for staff across all departments to collaborate, lead pilots, and serve as data stewards."

"Policy 188, data governance strategy — it's a framework that ensures data receives equivalent governance, attention, and protection. Privacy and security is our main thing, by the way. Fairness and access, transparency, accountability, and innovation."

"Policy 189, artificial intelligence — defines staff's understanding of AI and establishes an ethical framework. The framework addresses potential risks including algorithmic bias, policy concerns, and transparency challenges."

"Policy 189, artificial intelligence guiding principles: human-centered design, always putting the human in the middle; safety and security; privacy; transparency; fairness; accountability; effectiveness; and workforce empowerment."

"Next steps — if the proposed policies are adopted: the clerk's office will update the website, staff will update language and standard procedures, an interdepartmental data governance and AI committee will be formed, and a work plan will be developed."
